**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/24 (Wed) 12:28  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for new savory snack recipes to try out.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a list of savory snack recipes including:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Spicy Roasted Chickpeas: Rinse and dry a can of chickpeas, toss with olive oil, salt, and spices, roast at 400°F (200°C) for 30-40 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Herby Cheese Puffs: Mix grated Parmesan, chopped fresh herbs, a pinch of salt, and a beaten egg, roll out, cut into shapes, and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 15-20 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Korean-Style Fried Cauliflower Bites: Dip cauliflower florets in a flour and spice mixture, fry until crispy, toss with sesame seeds and scallions.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Savory Energy Balls: Mix rolled oats, almond butter, grated Parmesan, salt, fresh herbs, and lemon juice, roll into balls and refrigerate.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Crispy Fried Green Tomatoes: Slice green tomatoes, dredge in flour, eggs, and breadcrumb mixture, fry until crispy.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Smoky Pumpkin Seeds: Toss pumpkin seeds with olive oil, smoked paprika, salt, and cayenne, roast at 350°F (180°C) for 10-15 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Indian-Style Spiced Nuts: Mix nuts with ghee or oil, garam masala, cumin, coriander, and cayenne, roast at 350°F (180°C) for 10-15 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Crispy Baked Sweet Potato Fries: Slice sweet potatoes, toss with oil and spices, bake at 400°F (200°C) for 20-25 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Middle Eastern-Style Hummus Stuffed Pretzels: Mix hummus with herbs and lemon juice, spread on pretzels, top with sesame seeds and sumac.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. Japanese-Style Miso Glazed Pistachios: Mix pistachios with miso paste, soy sauce, and sugar, roast at 350°F (180°C) for 10-15 minutes.  
[PREFERENCE] User loves the Spicy Roasted Chickpeas recipe and has been on a savory snack kick for the past two weeks.  
[PREFERENCE] User has been stocking up on Kettle Brand chips, especially the Spicy Thai flavor, which they have had for lunch three days this week with hummus.
